problem: llama.cpp slot restore may report n_restored/n_read without effective restored recurrent compute state on hybrid Qwen3.5; receipt-only recovery acceptance can therefore be falsely positive.
authority_rule: Canonical transcript/state remains the correctness recovery source. llama.cpp KV/SSM/DeltaNet slot state is rebuildable accelerator state only.

minimum_test_matrix.model: exact Trigger-7 Qwen3.5-4B provenance-controlled baseline artifact
cases: restart -> canonical transcript replay -> identical continuation
measure: deterministic next-turn output digest where technically stable

acceptance_split.serialization_receipt: API/file operation completed and identities are bound
acceptance_split.logical_recovery: canonical replay reconstructs an admissible next turn
acceptance_split.compute_state_restore: restored run demonstrates real reusable compute state rather than full re-prefill
acceptance_split.latency_recovery: restored/replayed run meets declared voice-session latency budget

counterhypothesis_test: If canonical transcript replay on exact target hardware stays within latency budget at required voice-history lengths, disable or demote slot persistence instead of making correctness depend on it.
external_evidence: ggml-org/llama.cpp tools/server slot save/restore API documentation
next_exact_gate: Trigger 4 or the current authorized runtime owner binds exact Qwen3.5-4B + llama.cpp + chat-template + hardware identities and executes the four-case restore/replay matrix; preserve a failed restore as upstream/runtime negative evidence rather than F2 logic failure.
